method: Area websites, newsletters, minutes and election announcements searched 2026-10-19. Names reduced to first name + last initial.

areas.notes: The Oct 9-11, 2026 Area Assembly in Birmingham (Ramada Inn) was a voting assembly. Its agenda lists 'ROLL CALL / ELECTIONS', chaired by Luke B., Panel 75 Delegate, on Sat Oct 10, 2026, 9:45am, resuming at 1:30pm. The date has passed, but no results are posted on aaarea1.org: the home page, Members page (?page_id=343) and Contact page (?page_id=349, officer names blank) were all checked. The site has no news or WP API feed. The web search budget ran out, so district sites and newsletters were not searched. The election very likely took place, but the delegate's name is unverified.

Elections were held at the Fall Area Assembly on Oct 3-4, 2026 (hybrid, Holiday Inn Express, Russellville, plus Zoom). The event page says 'THIS IS OUR ELECTIONS MEETING' and is marked as passed; see also https://www.arkansasaa.org/assembly-information/. No results are published. The Area Contacts page names no one and still lists the Panel 73 heading, and the contact list and delegate pages are password-protected. The web search budget ran out partway through, so more searching might turn up results.

The SCAAN Fall 2026 newsletter, linked from area05aa.org/scaan, prints the summer assembly minutes. In them the Panel 75 delegate says that on Sunday, October 18th, the area will elect new officers for 2027-2028 (Panel 77). That election was held yesterday. Nothing published yet names the winners. Checked: the home page, the sitemap (latest change 2026-07-18), contact-us (Panel 75 positions only), the calendar PDF, the SCAAN page, and web searches. The /delegates-corner/ URL returns 404.

The October 2026 CNCA Comments newsletter lists the '2026 Fall Election Assembly, November 14, 2026, Hosted by Districts 20 & 7, Richmond Memorial Convention Center, Richmond, CA'. The cnca06.org home page also posts a preliminary flyer for the Fall Election Assembly on Nov 14 (in person and online). No results yet. Panel 75 delegate is Chitra S. and alternate is Claudia N.

The Winter 2026 Assembly runs Nov 6-8, 2026 at the DoubleTree by Hilton Greenwood Village (https://coloradoaa.org/assemblies/). The draft agenda for Sat Nov 7, 2026 has 'G. Elections: a. Southwest Regional Trustee Nominee, b. Delegate, c. Alternate Delegate, d. Area Chair, e. Secretary, f. Treasurer', starting in the 1:00 PM business session. The coloradoaa.org Delegate and Alternate Delegate pages give no names.

The flyer announces the Connecticut Area 11 Fall [Election] Assembly: Saturday, November 7, 2026, 9AM-4PM, at the William Pitkin Community Center, Wethersfield, CT, plus Zoom. It says 'HELP CHOOSE THE NEXT PANEL OF AREA 11 OFFICERS' and 'Elect Area 11 Officers', and the assembly will also select a nominee for Northeast Regional Trustee. The home page (https://ct-aa.org/) repeats 'Save The Date. November 7th VOTING ASSEMBLY.'

The events page lists 'Fall Assembly & Panel 77 Elections' for Sunday, Oct 18, 2026, 9 AM-1 PM, at John F. Kennedy HS in Silver Spring, MD. The slate is Delegate, Alternate Delegate, Chair, Treasurer and Secretary. No results are posted. Delegate's Corner still shows Panel 75 material. Also checked: home and about pages, the intergroup site aa-dc.org (latest New Reporter is the October 2026 issue, published before the election), and web searches.

The official agenda for the October 2-4 (2026) assembly lists 'Sunday, October 4, 9:00am, Elections Meeting (Español), Area 14, Grand Ballroom' (also on https://aanorthflorida.org/assembly_agenda.asp). The documents page offers a 'Service Resume for 2027-2028 Panel 77 Positions' form. The election date has passed, but no results are posted on the site (home, delegates, servicebodies, documents and Spanish pages all checked). Panel 75 delegate is Lori P.

The Area 15 October 2026 'Early Bird Minutes' (posted 2026-10-07) list the Panel 77 Election Results: Delegate Donna W.; Alternate Delegate Bron F.; Area Chairperson Alan T.; Treasurer Tom S.; Registrar Paul M.; Recording Secretary Debbie C. The election was held at the Oct 2-4, 2026 General Service Assembly at the Westin Cape Coral. The program (https://area15aa.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/2026-OCT-Program-Westin-Cape-Coral-Final.pdf) lists the 'Panel 77 Trusted Servant Election' on Sunday Oct 4 after the 9:00am Business Meeting. Under current practice the Alternate Delegate also chairs the State Convention committee.

The home page lists the 2026 Elections Assembly for Sat & Sun, November 7-8, 2026, 9am-5pm, at Queen Kaahumanu Elementary School, Honolulu, hosted by District 1 Diamond Head. The 2026 Budget Assembly agenda gives the same dates (https://area17aa.org/panel63/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/2026-Budget-Agenda-.pdf). Current Panel 75 officers are Delegate Deborah S. and Alternate Delegate Sean F.

The Area 20 links page gives the Area 19 site as chicagoaa.org. Every fetch of chicagoaa.org (home, /area-19/, /feed/) returned HTTP 403, so no election date or results could be checked. Web searches found nothing, and the session's WebSearch limit ran out partway through the task. The Panel 75 delegate is Robert J. (2025 Final Conference Report).

The Southern Illinois Area 21 Assembly agenda for Sunday, Sept 13, 2026 includes '11:15 am: Elections for Panel 77 Officers of Area 21' in this order: Delegate, Alternate Delegate, Chair, Registrar, Treasurer, Secretary, Alt. Chair. The guest election chair was Rich H. The agenda is posted on the District 11 GSR page (https://www.aaci11.org/gsr/). The District 11 minutes of Sept 20, 2026 have an 'Election results:' heading with nothing filled in. The area21aa.org GSC Info and DCM pages are password protected. No results found. Panel 75 delegate is Jodi B. and alternate is Pam B.

The Area 22 Delegate's Calendar lists an 'Election Assembly' on October 11, 2026, 11:00am-5:00pm. The 2026 Area 22 Handbook (https://area22indiana.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/2026-Area-22_Handbook_FINAL_Edit-2.pdf) says election assemblies are held in October of even years on the 2nd Sunday, hosted by District 57, with Delegate then Alternate elected by Third Legacy. The date has passed, but no results are posted on area22indiana.org: Committees & Officers still shows Panel 75 Delegate Karin O., and recent posts and media hold nothing. Results not found.

No document on aa-iowa.org explicitly announces the Panel 77 election date or results. The date given is my inference. The 2026 Area 24 Fall Conference (Oct 16-18, 2026, Cedar Falls) had Area Business Meetings on Saturday Oct 17, and DCMs/GSRs had to 'register to vote'. A Sunday 'Area 24 Officers and Chairs Transition Meeting' followed, which suggests elections took place there. The event page is marked as passed (https://www.aa-iowa.org/event/2026-area-24-fall-conference/). The site publishes no officer names, minutes, or results. The web search budget ran out partway through.

Area 27 Guidelines (3-24-26), Sec. V: 'Election Assemblies are held at the third quarter assembly in even-numbered years.' The Q3 2026 assembly was Aug 15-16, 2026, at the Holiday Inn Alexandria Downtown (https://aa-louisiana.org/event/louisiana-area-assembly-august-2026/). The event page does not itself call it an election assembly, which is why confidence is medium. The site never prints officer names: the contact page lists positions only. No results appear anywhere. Also checked: the sitemaps and media uploads (newest are only flyers), district sites for D7, D8, D12, D13E and D17 plus Acadiana, the Baton Rouge Central Office, and web searches.

The aaemass.org home page lists 'Nov. 1, 2026 Orientation 9:15 AM, Assembly 10 AM Election Assembly' at IBEW Local 103, Dorchester, MA. The area's linked Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dVkkXOPRmGk_xP9r5QrETfq8au7pjUsF) contains '2026-11-01 Area Election Assembly Area 30'. No delegate names were found on the site.

The Area 32 (CMIA 32) Handbook says Delegate and Alternate nominations open at the August meeting of even years and reopen at the October meeting, with elections held there after nominations close. Other officers are elected in December. The October 2026 assembly was Oct 4, 2026, 9am-3pm at Somerset Beach Campground, Jerome MI (flyer: https://www.cmia32.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Area-Assembly-Oct-2026-3-pdf-791x1024.jpg). The flyer itself does not mention elections. No results are posted: the minutes page only goes through April 2025, and the Contact-Officers page still lists Delegate Jon S. and Alternate Delegate James P. (Panel 75). The site URL is cmia32.org (not cmaa32.org).

Area 33 Guidelines and the Area Assembly page say October is the Election Assembly, with Area Officers (including Delegate) elected in October of even years. A search-engine snippet of the Area 33 Special Functions page (dated Oct 5, 2026) gave the October assembly as Oct 18, 2026 at Madison High School, Madison Heights. That date is inferred from the snippet and was not seen on the live page, which now shows the next assembly as Nov 15. The officers contact page (updated July 3, 2026) still lists P75 Delegate Cheryl B. and Alt. Edgar L. No Panel 77 results were published as of Oct 19.

The area36.org events API lists 'Area Assembly - Election & Budget' on 2026-10-17 at Jordan Community Center, Jordan MN (hybrid). Its agenda flyer ('2026-10-17 Assembly Election and Budget.pdf', from the area36.org flyers API) shows 'Area Elections' at 9:40 AM. The committees page still lists the current officers (Delegate Doug H., Alt Delegate Jennifer A.). The newest newsletter (The Pigeon) is June 2026. Area documents, recordings, Minneapolis intergroup and district sites have nothing posted after the election.

The Fall Assembly 2026 was Oct 3-4 at St. Louis Community College - Florissant Valley. The Sunday Oct 4 agenda (Drive PDF linked from eamo.org/fall2026) lists 'Third Legacy Elections' for Delegate, Alternate Delegate, Chair and the other officers, plus a candidate for Southwest Regional Trustee. The Fall 2026 Gratitude Gazette (issued before the election) still lists Delegate Jim L. and Alt Delegate Laura S., and names Becca H. as Panel 73 past delegate, which confirms the odd-panel cycle. The EAMO WP API shows no page or media posted after Oct 4 other than the Winter 2027 assembly page, whose PDFs are a map and image flyer. The Delegate Information page is password-protected.

The Area 39 (wamo-aa.org) agenda for the Panel 75 Assembly of September 19-20, 2026 (Sedalia MO, host District 14) includes 'Third Legacy Elections' (hybrid) and 'Area 39 Elections' under New Business at the Sunday Sept 20 business meeting. The Delegate's Corner lists 'Area Assembly (Election)' on Sept 19-20. The date has passed, but no results are posted: the Delegate's Corner and About pages still show Delegate Greg G. and Alt Delegate Jon M. (Panel 75), and the September minutes are not yet posted. Results not found.

District 61 (Helena) business meeting minutes of Oct 1, 2026, posted on the area website, contain this DCM report: 'we did elect a new slate of Area officers... congrats to Jessica EW from Kalispell who was elected to be our new delegate.' Recorded as first name plus last initial; the agenda prints her as 'Jessica E. W.', and she was the Panel 75-term Area Chair. The Fall Assembly agenda (https://www.aa-montana.org/pdf/area/2026FallAssemblyAgenda.pdf) put the 'Area 40 Elections' on Saturday Sept 26, 1:30-3:30 pm, for Delegate, Area Chair/Alternate Delegate, Treasurer and Secretary. In Area 40 the alternate delegate is the combined Area Chair/Alternate Delegate seat, and no published source names who won it, so the alternate is left null. The source is a district report, not area minutes; the Fall 2026 assembly minutes are not posted yet.

Elected at the Area 42 election assembly (Sept 11-13, 2026, Tonopah; Panel 77 elections began Sat Sept 12). The area website had not posted results as of 2026-10-19; the source URL is the assembly agenda. Alternate not known.

The official flyer, linked from the nnjaa.org calendar for October 2026, reads 'N.N.J.G.S. Area 44 Election Assembly'. It was set for Saturday, October 17, 2026 at the Sayreville Adult Center, Sayreville NJ, to elect the Delegate, Alt Delegate, Chair, Alt Chair/Coordinator, Treasurer, Alt Treasurer, Recording Secretary, Alt Secretary, Registrar and Alt Registrar, plus the Area 44 nominee for Northeast Regional Trustee. The assembly was held only 2 days ago, and no result is posted on nnjaa.org (the news, events, calendar and contacts pages give only role-based e-mail addresses). The 'Share44 Portal' at njarea44.org redirects to a private SharePoint. The Fall 2026 'This Day' newsletter came out before the election.

The Area 47 minutes of the September 13, 2026 assembly (Syracuse NY and online) have an 'AREA ELECTIONS - PANEL 77' section, moderated by past delegate Christopher M. Results: Delegate Liza C. (Canandaigua); Alternate Delegate Brian M. (Rochester); Area Chairperson Bonnie G.; Treasurer Greg K.; Registrar Franklin H.; Recording Secretary Katherine W. The Secretary-elect resigned and that seat goes to a Third Legacy vote at the next assembly. The outgoing Panel 75 delegate is Cindy D. The minutes are pending approval at the October assembly.

The home page lists the 'Election Assembly (Hybrid)' for Saturday, September 19, 2026, 10:00AM-3:00PM. As of Oct 19, 2026 the home page still shows 'YOUR PANEL 75 OFFICERS': Delegate Nisaa A. and Alternate Delegate Jeanne C. No Panel 77 results appear on the assembly documents page (https://aaseny.org/assembly-documents), the minutes page (latest Nov 2025), or a site search for 'panel 77'. Results not found. The web search budget ran out partway through.

The Area 51 Service Guidelines (P3 Manual, 2026) say 'In Area 51, the normal election assembly is held in the fall of even-numbered years.' The members page (https://aanorthcarolina.org/information-for-members/) lists the 'Area 51 Fall Committee & Assembly Meeting' on Nov 6-8, 2026 at the Hilton Raleigh North Hills. The assembly and officer pages require a login. The Panel 75 delegate is Denise M.

The Area 52 Fall Assembly agenda (Sept 12, 2026, Ramada Inn, Fargo ND) includes an 'Elections' item at 2:00 pm (event page: https://aanorthdakota.org/events/area-52-assembly-3/). The agenda does not say 'Panel 77' outright. No results are posted, the Area 52 Service Information page is password protected, and the Delegate Reports page stops at Panel 72.

An Area 53 news post, 'Panel 77 Election Results' (Sept 15, 2026), lists Panel 77 officers serving 2027-2028: Delegate Marcia H.; Alternate Delegate Tommy O.; Chair Kyle M.; Alt Chair Jenniffer R.; Treasurer Maria C.; Alt Treasurer James G.; Secretary Mela K.; Alt Secretary Erin P.; Registrar Kari B.; Alt Registrar Dave H. The Area 53 events calendar lists the 'Area 53 Elections Assembly (Panel 77)' on Sept 13, 2026 at 10:00am (https://area53aa.org/event/area-53-elections-assembly-panel-77/).

The Sept 20, 2026 assembly minutes say the next hybrid Assembly is Oct 18 at the 12-Step Club and 'Elections will be held'. The 2026 schedule trifold (http://area54.org/pdfs/2026-Trifold.pdf) lists 'October 18: Hybrid Area Assembly/Elections'. The Oct 18 assembly took place one day before this check, so no results are posted yet. The Oct 18 agenda (https://area54.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Area-54-Agenda-10-18-26.pdf) lists Delegate Beverly F. and Alternate Delegate Wellington R. (Panel 75). The minutes mention some members willing to stand, but no one is known to have been elected.

New, status changed from unknown. The Area 57 Policy and Procedure Manual, last revised 4/21/2022, says the Delegate, Alt Delegate, Chair, Alt Chair, Treasurer and Alt Treasurer 'are elected biennially (even numbered years) ... at the September Area General Assembly'. Terms begin at the close of the December Area Committee Meeting. The manual is archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20240207102845/https://aaoklahoma.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Policy-and-Procedure-Manual-Area-57.pdf. The aaoklahoma.org events calendar lists an 'Area 57 Annual Assembly' on Sept 13, 2026, 9am-5pm, at Embassy Suites OU Med Center in OKC (marked as passed). So the Panel 77 election very likely took place Sept 13, but the event page itself does not say 'election'. No names are published: the officers page gives titles only, and the area meeting documents are password-protected (not accessed). The Panel 75 delegate is Bryan T. and the alternate is Mary Beth H., per the Dec 2025 Area 57 newsletter. Next Area quarterly meeting: Dec 6, 2026.

The 69th EPGSA runs Nov 13-15, 2026 at the Wyndham Lancaster Resort. The program lists the Area 59 Assembly on Saturday Nov 14, 2026, 8:45 am to about 3:00 pm, with Election Chair Matt K. The event page (https://area59aa.org/calendar/69th-annual-eastern-pennsylvania-general-service-convention-and-assembly-epgsa/) says 'In even-numbered years (like 2026), we have elections for the Delegate and Area Officers'. A 'P75 & P77 Area Changeover Meeting' follows on Dec 13, 2026. Panel 75 delegate is Dan B. and alternate is Alex N., per the Sept 13, 2026 minutes.

The Area 60 event page 'Area 60 Election Assembly 2026' gives Oct 04 2026, 8:30am-1:00pm, at the Greater Pittsburgh Masonic Center, Pittsburgh PA. It is now marked 'Expired', with no description or results. No results are posted elsewhere on wpaarea60.org: the Contacts page still lists Delegate Mario D. and Alternate Delegate Tami D. (Panel 75), the newest newsletter is Q3 2025, and recent media and pages hold nothing. Results not found.
Elected at the NETA 65 fall election assembly (Sept 18-20, 2026).

Elected at the SETA General Assembly - Elections (Saturday, October 3, 2026, hybrid). The area website had not posted results as of 2026-10-19; the source URL is the home page that lists the election assembly. Alternate not known.

Elected at the Area 69 Fall Assembly Elections (Sept 25-27, 2026, District 3, Kamas). The area website had not posted results as of 2026-10-19; the source URL is the Area 69 Calendar of Events PDF that lists the election assembly (linked from https://sites.google.com/aaofutah.org/aa-of-utah/area-69-events). Alternate not known.

The VAC 2026 Fall Assembly runs Oct 16-18, 2026 at the Falls Church Marriott Fairview Park (https://aavirginia.org/event/vac-2026-fall-assembly/). Its agenda lists 'Elections / Business Session' on Sat Oct 17, 2026 at 2:30pm. That was two days ago and no results are posted yet: there are no new posts, newsletters are password-protected, and the Contacts page shows emails only, no names. Check aavirginia.org again soon.

Source is the official 'Western Washington Area 72 October 2026 Assembly Business Meeting Minutes' (Little Creek Casino, Shelton WA, Oct 3-4, 2026), linked from the District 46 site's Area 72 page. area72aa.org refused connections from here (ECONNREFUSED). Elections are the first business in the minutes, so 2026-10-03 is inferred as the day. Delegate: Lupita (printed as 'Lupita YM', recorded here as 'Lupita Y.'), current Alternate Delegate, elected on the 3rd ballot under Third Legacy with two-thirds against Jennifer R. Alternate Delegate: Derek S., current Area Chair, chosen by lot ('the hat') after 4 ballots against Jennifer. Other officers elected: Chair Lisa S., Alt Chair Jennifer R., Treasurer Eddy M-M. The area newsletter (news.area72aa.org) post-assembly articles are members-only.

The previous finding had no date; this pass resolved it. The Area 73 Newsletter for September 2026 (a PDF linked from https://www.aawv.org/members/area-73-news-letter) has the flyer '2026 FALL ASSEMBLY SEPTEMBER 11-13 ELECTIONS ASSEMBLY, Wingate by Wyndham, Elkins, WV.' It reads: '9/12/26: 9:00am Area business meeting and Area elections for Panel 77 Service Term.' No October or November newsletter is posted; the newsletter page shows only the September issue. The Delegates Corner still refers to the Panel 75 delegate's 76th GSC report. The contact page lists roles and emails only, with no names. District websites listed in the newsletter (D1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 16) were checked and none mention the results.

The Area 75 Handbook (rev. July 2026) says: 'Elections are held at the Fall Conference Assembly in even-numbered years', 'held in conjunction with the Fall Conference', and officers serve terms starting January 1 of odd-numbered years. The area75.org home page lists the 'Area 75 Conference: Fri Nov 6 - Sun Nov 8, The Ingleside Hotel, Pewaukee, WI', and Fri Nov 6 falls in 2026. The listing does not itself mention elections or give an exact election day.

The '2026 October Voting & Election Assembly' runs October 23-25, 2026 at the Alberni Athletic Hall, Port Alberni BC (host District 6, in person and online). The event page does not list the positions up for election. The Area 79 'Elections & Appointments' info sheet (https://bcyukonaa.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/elections-appointments-more-info_42.pdf, posted Sept 2026) lists the seven elected officers, including Delegate and Alternate Delegate. It also mentions an 'incoming Chair' and a December transition meeting 'after the election assembly'. That supports officer and delegate elections at this assembly, but the full agenda package was not readable to confirm. The site still references the Panel 75 calendar.

The agenda is titled 'Area 82 NL/NS Fall Assembly 2026 (election year)', Oct. 9-11, 2026, Corner Brook, NL. Its Saturday program includes elections run by a GSO guest, starting with 1. Delegate and 2. Alternate Delegate. Some agenda rows are mislabeled Oct 10-12, but the header says Oct 9-11 and Saturday was Oct 10. The contacts page (https://area82aa.org/contacts-2/) still lists Delegate Dwayne MacD. and Alternate Paul B., and the October district newsletters reviewed contain no results. Results not found.

Ottawa Area Intergroup event page: 'Fall Area 83 Assembly and Service Information Day', Oct 30 - Nov 1, 2026, St. Lawrence College, Kingston (hybrid). The Sunday Nov 1 Area Assembly includes 'the election of Area Officers for Panel 77 (2027 to 2028)' and the election of Area 83's nominee for Class B Trustee-at-Large. The Area 83 Operating Procedures say officer elections (Delegate first) are held at the Fall Assembly before the new term. The area's own 'Upcoming Assembly 2026' page is behind a members login.

I could not find the official Area 85 website: the guessed domains (area85aa.org, area85aa.ca, area85.ca, aanwo.ca, etc.) do not resolve, and neighboring area sites do not link to it. The shared web-search budget ran out before I could locate it, so no election date or results were found.

The Région 88 2026 calendar lists '14 novembre - Ass. gén. annuelle: Cap-St-Ignace (09)'. Région 88 elects at its November AGA. The Nov 16, 2024 AGA minutes (https://aaregion88.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/ASSEMBLE-GENERALE-16-novembre-2024.pdf) show Panel 75 Delegate Jean-Yves M. and Délégué adjoint Paule R. elected there. So the Panel 77 election is expected at the Nov 14, 2026 AGA, but no 2026 notice explicitly says the delegate election falls on that date. Site: aaregion88.org (aa88.org returns 404).

The Région 89 2026 service calendar lists an Assemblée générale on Saturday Oct 3, 2026, 9 h, in Charlevoix/Côte-Nord. It notes 'Assemblées générales 2027-2028 : Tirage au sort en octobre 2026, lors des élections', so elections took place at the October 2026 general assembly. Neither the delegate's corner page (https://aa89.org/coin-delegue/) nor the home page shows any results or names, and the latest NORDET issue (Aug-Sep) predates the election. Results not found.

The Area 91 Fall Assembly was Oct 16-18, 2026, at Our Lady of Peace Church Hall, Meadow Lake SK, and the event page says 'This event has passed'. The Area 91 Guidelines (aasask.org/guidelines/files/Area 91 Guidelines.pdf) say 'The Election Assembly (held in even years in October)'. Officers take office Jan 1 of odd years, and elections come before regular business. The Saturday date (Oct 17) is inferred, not stated. Nothing published names a result: the area-service-positions page still lists Delegate Alison G. and Alternate Jim J., and the WP media library has no post-assembly uploads besides a district map. A District 7 poster (Nov 7, 2026) still bills 'Alison G-T, Area 91 Delegate'.

The event is listed as 'Area Elections & Assembly', November 14 (8:00 am) to November 15 (5:00 pm PST), 2026, at the Morro Bay Veterans Building, Morro Bay, CA. The page says only 'Elections' and does not mention Panel 77 explicitly. Officer names are not published on area93.org/trusted-servants.
